broker.name: Deriv
broker.tagline: On its own site since 1999. Its site names 5 regulators, including FSC (BVI), CIMA, and FSC (Mauritius). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: Deriv says it has operated since 1999. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include MT5 CFDs, MT5 Financial, MT5 Zero Spread, MT5 Swap-free, MT5 Gold, and MT5 Crypto. Platforms named there include TradingView, Deriv MT5, Deriv cTrader, Deriv Trader, Deriv Bot, and Deriv Exchange. The site names these regulators: FSC (BVI), CIMA, FSC (Mauritius), VFSC, and LFSA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. A minimum deposit figure on the site is 5 USD. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSC (BVI): Deriv (BVI) Ltd. CIMA: Deriv Investments (Cayman) Limited. FSC (Mauritius): Deriv (Mauritius) Ltd. VFSC: Deriv (V) Ltd. LFSA: Deriv (FX) Ltd.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: CFD page advertises high leverage up to 1:1000. Help centre says MT5 leverage cannot be changed manually and is fixed by the asset.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Help centre: the minimum deposit into the Deriv Wallet is 5 USD, or the equivalent in other currencies. It also says the lowest deposit amount is 5 USD to the wallet, while some payment methods show their own minimums. A separate MT5 bonus rule, for a promotion that has ended, required 1 USD.

other_fees.label: CFD commission
other_fees.note: CFD page says commission-free CFD trading on TradingView, Deriv MT5 and Deriv cTrader.

_notes.fetch_notes: Fetched on 2026-10-11. Founded is taken from the regulatory page sentence 'Since 1999'. No single headquarters is named. The Guernsey address is the holding company's registered address, so it is not stored as headquarters. Licensed entities are listed without licence numbers. The page also says the group is registered with the Financial Commission for dispute resolution; that is not listed as a regulator. Deriv (SVG) LLC and the Samoa company are registered on the page without a licence statement. CFD page says zero-balance protection so losses are limited to deposited funds.
